name: Linkify for WordPress – Internal Links, Breadcrumbs, TOC & Related Posts Plugin
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Automate WordPress internal linking with Linkify – the internal linking plugin that generates breadcrumbs, table of contents, contextual links, and related posts automatically to boost SEO.

Stop manually creating internal links and breadcrumb navigation. Linkify analyzes your WordPress content and automatically generates contextual internal links, SEO-friendly breadcrumbs, table of contents for long posts, and related content sections – all working together to improve WordPress SEO and keep visitors engaged longer on your site.

Whether you’re optimizing existing content for SEO, building site architecture, or improving user navigation, Linkify makes WordPress internal linking automatic and intelligent.

Why Choose Linkify?

  • WordPress Internal Links – Automatic contextual linking between posts
  • Breadcrumbs Navigation – SEO-friendly breadcrumbs for site hierarchy
  • Table of Contents – Auto-generated TOC from post headings
  • Related Posts – Content similarity algorithm for recommendations
  • SEO Boost – Improve internal link structure for better rankings
  • Performance Optimized – Smart caching for fast page loads

How WordPress Internal Linking Works

  1. Install and activate Linkify on your WordPress site
  2. Navigate to Linkify in WordPress admin menu
  3. Enable features: Breadcrumbs, Table of Contents, Contextual Links, Related Posts
  4. Configure settings for each internal linking feature
  5. Linkify analyzes content and generates internal links automatically
  6. Breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts appear on WordPress posts

Zero manual work required – Linkify creates WordPress internal links automatically based on content analysis.

Perfect For

  • SEO Specialists optimizing WordPress internal link structure
  • Content Marketers improving content discoverability
  • Bloggers creating better user navigation with breadcrumbs
  • Publishers adding table of contents to long articles
  • WordPress Developers automating internal linking for clients
  • E-commerce Sites connecting related product content

WordPress Internal Linking Features

Automatic Internal Links
Linkify analyzes WordPress content and automatically creates contextual internal links between related posts. Intelligent keyword matching finds relevant content and links keywords naturally. Improve WordPress SEO with automated internal linking that strengthens site architecture.

WordPress Breadcrumbs
Add SEO-friendly breadcrumbs to WordPress posts and pages automatically. Breadcrumb navigation shows site hierarchy, improves user experience, and helps search engines understand content structure. WordPress breadcrumbs display before post titles with customizable styling.

Table of Contents Plugin
Auto-generate table of contents from WordPress post headings (H1-H6). TOC appears at the beginning of posts, helping readers navigate long content. Improves user experience and SEO by organizing WordPress content structure with clickable anchor links.

Related Posts WordPress
Display related posts based on content similarity analysis. Advanced algorithm compares WordPress posts to find relevant recommendations. Keep visitors engaged longer by showing related content automatically at the end of posts.

Contextual Link Building
Intelligent contextual linking automatically links keywords to relevant WordPress content. No manual link insertion required – Linkify analyzes content and creates natural internal links that improve SEO and user navigation throughout WordPress site.

Performance Caching
Built-in caching system ensures WordPress internal linking doesn’t slow down your site. Internal links, breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts are generated once and cached for fast page loads. Clear and regenerate cache when updating WordPress content.

Usage

Once the WordPress internal linking plugin is installed and activated:

  1. Navigate to Linkify in WordPress admin menu
  2. Go to Options tab to select supported post types
  3. Enable desired features: Breadcrumbs, Table of Contents, Contextual Links, Related Posts
  4. Customize settings for each internal linking feature
  5. Configure keyword threshold for contextual links
  6. Set number of related posts to display
  7. Save settings and clear cache if needed
  8. Visit WordPress posts to see automatic internal linking

Here are the steps to use Linkify:

  1. Enable Features – Turn on Breadcrumbs, TOC, Contextual Links, Related Posts
  2. Select Post Types – Choose which WordPress content types get internal links
  3. Configure Settings – Adjust keyword threshold and related post count
  4. Clear Cache – Regenerate when making significant changes
  5. View Results – Automatic internal linking appears on WordPress posts

Note: Plugin analyzes existing WordPress content to create internal links. No content is modified in database.

WordPress Internal Linking Settings

Post Type Configuration:
1. Go to Linkify > Options in WordPress admin
2. Select post types for internal linking (Posts, Pages, Custom Post Types)
3. Save settings to apply to selected WordPress content

Enable Linking Features:
1. Navigate to Linkify dashboard
2. Enable Breadcrumbs for WordPress navigation hierarchy
3. Enable Table of Contents to auto-generate TOC from headings
4. Enable Contextual Links for automatic keyword linking
5. Enable Related Posts for content recommendations
6. Configure feature-specific settings

Contextual Links Settings:
1. Set keyword threshold for internal link generation
2. Configure how many contextual links per post
3. Adjust matching algorithm sensitivity
4. Exclude specific posts by ID from internal linking

Cache Management:
1. Access Linkify dashboard
2. Click Clear Cache to remove cached internal links
3. Click Regenerate to rebuild all internal links
4. Cache ensures fast WordPress performance

Supported WordPress Features:
– Posts internal linking
– Pages breadcrumbs
– Custom post types
– Table of contents
– Related posts recommendations

Features & Limitations

The Linkify WordPress internal linking plugin allows you to:

  • Automatically generate internal links between WordPress posts
  • Add SEO-friendly breadcrumbs to WordPress navigation
  • Create table of contents from post headings automatically
  • Display related posts based on content similarity
  • Improve WordPress SEO with internal link structure
  • Enhance user navigation with breadcrumbs and TOC
  • Keep visitors engaged with related content recommendations
  • Configure internal linking per post type
  • Exclude specific posts from internal linking
  • Use built-in caching for WordPress performance
  • Support custom post types for internal linking
  • Clear and regenerate internal links cache

WordPress Internal Linking Components

Breadcrumbs System
Automatic WordPress breadcrumbs show site hierarchy on posts and pages. Breadcrumb navigation helps users understand their location and improves SEO by creating clear site structure. Breadcrumbs display before post titles with Home > Category > Post format.

Table of Contents Generator
Auto-generate TOC from WordPress post headings (H1-H6). Table of contents appears at beginning of long posts with anchor links to each section. Improves WordPress user experience and SEO by organizing content structure.

Contextual Linking Engine
Intelligent algorithm analyzes WordPress content to create contextual internal links automatically. Keyword matching finds relevant posts and links naturally within content. Strengthens WordPress internal link structure for better SEO.

Related Posts Algorithm
Content similarity analysis compares WordPress posts to find relevant recommendations. Related posts display at end of content with thumbnails and titles. Keeps visitors engaged by surfacing related WordPress content automatically.

Cache System
Performance-optimized caching ensures WordPress internal linking doesn’t slow down site. Internal links, breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts are generated once and cached. Clear cache when updating content or changing settings.

Post Type Support
Configure internal linking for any WordPress post type including Posts, Pages, and custom post types. Enable/disable features per post type for granular control over internal linking strategy.

Known Limitations

Free version features:

  • Breadcrumbs – Basic styling (Advanced customization in Pro)
  • Table of Contents – Standard layout (Multiple layouts in Pro)
  • Contextual Links – Automatic generation (Per-post control in Pro)
  • Related Posts – Content similarity (Advanced analytics in Pro)
  • Design Options – Basic styling (Design dashboard in Pro)
  • Analytics – None (Performance tracking in Pro)
  • Per-Post Settings – Not available (Individual post control in Pro)
  • Priority Support – Community only (Direct support in Pro)

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, WordPress internal linking best practices, and SEO tips on the Linkify Documentation page.

Linkify Pro

If you’re using the free WordPress internal linking plugin from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the Linkify Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • Analytics Dashboard – Track WordPress internal link performance and click-through rates
  • Design Customization – Multiple layout options for TOC, breadcrumbs, and related posts
  • Per-Post Settings – Configure internal linking options individually per WordPress post
  • Design Dashboard – Customize appearance of all internal linking elements
  • Dashboard Widget – Quick access to internal linking metrics and statistics
  • Advanced TOC – Multiple table of contents layouts and styling options
  • Custom Breadcrumbs – Advanced breadcrumb design and structure options
  • Link Analytics – Track which internal links get the most clicks
  • Bulk Management – Configure internal linking for multiple WordPress posts
  • Priority Support – Direct email support from WordPress internal linking experts
  • Regular Updates – Early access to new internal linking features and improvements
sections.installation:
Installing the WordPress internal linking plugin is straightforward. Contact support if you encounter any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Gutenberg Block Editor or Classic Editor

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Linkify
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Navigate to Linkify in admin menu

Manual Installation

  1. Download the WordPress internal linking plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the linkify-links folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate Linkify
  5. Navigate to Linkify in admin menu

After Activation

  1. Go to Linkify > Options to select WordPress post types
  2. Enable desired internal linking features:
    • Breadcrumbs for WordPress navigation
    • Table of Contents for long posts
    • Contextual Links for automatic internal linking
    • Related Posts for content recommendations
  3. Configure feature-specific settings
  4. Adjust keyword threshold for contextual links
  5. Set number of related posts to display
  6. Save settings and clear cache if needed
  7. Visit WordPress posts to see automatic internal linking in action

Quick Start:
1. Enable Breadcrumbs feature
2. Enable Table of Contents
3. Enable Contextual Links
4. Enable Related Posts
5. Save settings – automatic internal linking is now active!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a couple of working days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

How does WordPress internal linking improve SEO?

Internal links help search engines discover content, understand site structure, and distribute page authority. Linkify automatically creates contextual internal links that strengthen WordPress SEO by connecting related content and improving site architecture.

What’s the best WordPress internal linking plugin?

Linkify provides automatic internal linking for WordPress with breadcrumbs, table of contents, contextual links, and related posts. Built-in caching, content similarity analysis, and intelligent keyword matching make it ideal for WordPress SEO optimization.

How to add breadcrumbs to WordPress?

Install Linkify, go to the plugin dashboard, enable Breadcrumbs feature, and save. WordPress breadcrumbs automatically appear before post titles showing site hierarchy (Home > Category > Post).

How to create table of contents in WordPress?

Enable the Table of Contents feature in Linkify settings. TOC automatically generates from post headings (H1-H6) and displays at the beginning of WordPress posts with clickable anchor links.

Does Linkify slow down WordPress?

No, Linkify uses efficient caching to ensure WordPress internal linking doesn’t impact performance. Internal links, breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts are generated once and cached for fast page loads.

Can I customize breadcrumbs appearance?

Basic breadcrumb styling is included in the free version. Linkify Pro offers extensive design customization for WordPress breadcrumbs with multiple layout options.

How does contextual linking work?

Linkify analyzes WordPress content to identify keywords and find related posts. Contextual links are automatically inserted by matching keywords with relevant content, creating natural internal links that improve SEO.

Can I control which posts get internal links?

Yes, select post types in Linkify options and exclude specific posts by ID. Pro version includes per-post settings for granular WordPress internal linking control.

Does this work with Gutenberg Block Editor?

Yes, Linkify is fully compatible with WordPress Gutenberg Block Editor and Classic Editor. Internal linking, breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts work seamlessly with both editors.

How are related posts determined?

Linkify uses content similarity analysis to compare WordPress posts. Advanced algorithm analyzes keywords, categories, tags, and content to find the most relevant related posts for recommendations.

Can I use Linkify with custom post types?

Yes, Linkify supports WordPress custom post types. Select which post types should have internal linking in the plugin options to enable breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts for custom content.

Will Linkify modify my WordPress content?

No, Linkify does not modify content in your WordPress database. Internal links, breadcrumbs, TOC, and related posts are generated dynamically and cached without altering original post content.

How to clear internal links cache?

Go to Linkify dashboard and click Clear Cache button. This removes cached internal links, breadcrumbs, and related posts. Click Regenerate to rebuild cache with updated WordPress content.

Does this work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, Linkify is compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Configure internal linking settings independently for each site in your WordPress network.

Can I see internal link analytics?

Internal link performance tracking is available in Linkify Pro. Analytics dashboard shows click-through rates, most linked content, and WordPress internal linking effectiveness.

How many related posts can I show?

Configure the number of related posts to display in Linkify settings. Choose how many related content recommendations appear at the end of each WordPress post.
